vars.goal: a title menu as the main scene res://main.tscn (root Main) with Menu/StartButton, Menu/SettingsButton and Menu/QuitButton, where Start adds the game scene res://game/game.tscn as a child of Main named Game and hides Menu; pause: the button HUD/PauseButton of the game (or Escape) shows its PauseMenu node (a CanvasLayer with ResumeButton and QuitButton) and pauses the tree, ResumeButton hides it and resumes; levels 2 and 3 after level 1, each a scene in levels/ (a Level with Start, Platforms, Moss, Beetles, Checkpoints and Beacon), listed in order by a Levels class (scripts/levels.gd: static from_files(), count(), level(number) -> {id, number, scene, name}, beetle(id)) from data/levels.json and data/beetles.json; a data.json for the kit's data runner; and a save of the furthest level reached by a SaveStore class (scripts/save_store.gd: SaveStore.new(path), read() and write(data) of a dictionary with unlocked) in user://save.json
